**Summary of findings:**
- **GDG Taichung** (969 members) is the anchor — free monthly **Build with AI** workshops at Feng Chia University's AI Foundry, plus annual **DevFest Taichung** every November (~250 attendees, free)
- **Industry forums in 2026**: D Forum Smart Factory (March, Digitimes), Taiwan AI Academy Central Taiwan Forum (April, at FCU) — both past, watch for 2027 editions
- **TICEC** — Taiwan's newest major convention center opened March 2026 in Xitun District; already hosts 50+ expos and 300+ conferences for the year; **TMTS 2026** (machine tool / smart manufacturing, 400 companies) was its first big tech event
- **National events** (COMPUTEX, COSCUP, SITCON) are all Taipei-based, ~50 min by HSR; MOPCON is Kaohsiung
